facts.text: Adelaide won the Thriller shirt. You won these.
facts.why: Adelaide's father wins her the Thriller T-shirt at the boardwalk. She does not win it herself.
facts.fix: Adelaide's dad won the Thriller shirt. You won these.

facts.text: Five bucks on the counter. I got five on it.
facts.why: The line riffs on the lyrics of the Luniz song 'I Got 5 on It', which the film does use, but the rule is no song lyrics on a menu.

vibe.verdict: Dark funhouse board with the right symbols, but the food is generic and the tone is thin.
